Added D111, a CHANGELOG entry and enforcement row M33. In this round I added the missing ontology term 'spec'. That term made the ontology test, which pins the exact set of terms, fail, so I added \"spec\" to its list and dropped \"seven\" from the test's name. fmt and clippy are clean. `cargo test -p xtask --test spec` passes 15 of 15. The full `cargo test --locked` still has one failure, `every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists` in policy.rs. It lists the new tests from the M33 row as missing because that test finds Rust files with `git ls-files` and spec.rs is not tracked yet. I may not stage files and did not touch policy.rs.
